qc.label_under_test: The word-onset fragment of a concrete noun the tokenizer splits (' le'|che, ' ro'|edores, ' к'|ружку, ' ar'|ctic), mostly foods and animals

neighbours.label: A short opening piece (' ro', ' le', ' wh', ' к') of a rare concrete noun or place name that the tokenizer splits (food, animal, object, town); whole-word nouns, abstract words, verbs and adjectives stay quiet
fire: At the seaside stall we bought a paper cup of whelks drenched in vinegar.
She brewed a pot of rooibos and let it steep for five minutes.
The bakery in Nuremberg sells lebkuchen wrapped in tin boxes every December.
We drove through Leominster on the way to the Welsh border.
A wheatear landed on the stone wall and flicked its tail.
He crumbled some Roquefort over the pear salad.
On the market table lay a pile of hairy red rambutans.
The ferry to Whitstable was cancelled because of the storm.
quiet: At the seaside stall we bought a paper cup of shrimp drenched in vinegar.
She brewed a pot of tea and let it steep for five minutes.
The bakery in the city sells cookies wrapped in tin boxes every December.
We drove through the town on the way to the Welsh border.
A small bird landed on the stone wall and flicked its tail.
He crumbled some cheese over the pear salad.
On the market table lay a pile of fresh red apples.
The ferry to the island was cancelled because of the storm.

predictions: Expect about 5/8 fire to reach 0.2 (short ro/le/wh pieces); long-piece words like rambutans or wheatear may miss; near misses stay near 0.
